```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(reactable)


```

```{r}
df = read.csv('http://manctsui.github.io/datasets/countries.csv')
reactable(df, defaultPageSize = 4, searchable = T)

```

#Net migration

Net Migration is given by the following formula: 
$$
\text{Migration into country} - \text{Migration out of country}
$$

:::{fig-countries-migration}
```{r}
#|code-fold: true
#|llayout-ncol: 2

least = df |>
  arrange(Net.migration) |>
  head(3) |>
  select("Most Negative Net Migration" = Country)

reactable(least)
```
Countries with extreme net migration
